protocol.trainingLoss: normalized returns; h1 weight .6, later .4/11; Huber beta=.5 or MSE; direction candidate adds .1 BCE h1 with fixed temperature1
protocol.checkpointSelection: validation normalized return MSE: .8*h1+.2*mean(h2..h12); early stop6; no shrinkage or amplitude floor
protocol.candidates: 3 individual seeds plus equal-weight ensemble per objective; flat and train-mean baselines
protocol.promotionGate: validation h1 R2vsZero>0; MSE beats train-mean; PearsonIC>.02; balancedAccuracy>.5; priceMAE<=flat*1.005; >=2 of3 time blocks both positive R2vsZero and IC
protocol.selection: among eligible choose minimum validation score; if none, best candidate is diagnostic only and must not be promoted
protocol.evaluationStatus: same historical holdout reevaluation, not fresh unseen data; no test data used in candidate, checkpoint or promotion selection
protocol.deployment: No deployed model file modified. Ensembles require additional JS runtime support; constituent models use existing weight schema.
